title: Defining Microsoft Information Protection Labels for Custom DLP Dictionaries

blocks.text: You can add Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) labels to custom Data Loss Prevention (DLP). To learn more, see Adding Custom DLP Dictionaries.

Before you can add MIP labels to a custom dictionary, you must add an MIP account in the Zscaler Admin Console and retrieve the MIP labels from Microsoft to the MIP account. To learn more, see Adding an MIP Account and Retrieving MIP Labels from Microsoft to the MIP Account.
To define MIP labels for custom DLP dictionaries:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Common Resources > Dictionaries & Engines.
On the DLP Dictionaries tab, click Add DLP Dictionary or click the Edit icon next to an existing Microsoft Information Protection type dictionary.
The Add DLP Dictionary or Edit DLP Dictionary page appears.
On the Add DLP Dictionary page:
Select Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) as the Dictionary Type.
On the Edit DLP Dictionary page, the Dictionary Type is displayed as Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) and cannot be changed.
In the Match On table, select the labels for the dictionary. A maximum of 256 labels can be selected for each custom dictionary.
You can't select deleted labels. Any labels that are deleted from the Azure platform display with a strike through line in the table.
Click Save and activate the change.
